question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Anger
solution: The correct answer is **"Fury."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Anger"** means the strong feeling that you have when something has happened or somebody has done something that you do not like. (क्रोध, ग़ुस्‍सा, रोष) • **Example**: *He could not hide his **anger**__ at the news.* • Synonyms of **Angry** include **rage, wrath, and fury**. • **"Fury"** means extreme anger, similar to the given word Anger. (अत्‍यधिक क्रोध; उन्‍माद) __ • **Example**: *His **fury**__ was evident as he slammed the door shut.* • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Delight** means great pleasure or satisfaction. (अत्‍यंत प्रसन्‍नता; आनंद) • **Frenzy** means a state of wild excitement or madness. (नियंत्रण-विहीन अत्‍यधिक उत्तेजना या हलचल; उन्‍माद, पागलपन) • **Dismay** means a feeling of disappointment or distress. (प्रबल निराशा और व्‍याकुलता) 30:T8b3, The correct answer is **"My favourite subject is Mathematics."**
